author: nickyeow

english.text: Never try to die.

jyutping: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 zi6 saat3。
text: 千祈唔好自殺。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Have you read this article?

jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 gwo3 nei1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 aa3？
text: 你有冇睇過呢篇文章呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: What fruit is red?

jyutping: jau5 me1 saang1 gwo2 hai6 hung4 sik1 gaa3？
text: 有咩生果係紅色㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: At first he did not realize that he had won the speech contest.

jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoi1 ci2 go2 zan6 dou1 m4 zi1 zi6 gei2 jing4 zo2 coeng4 jin2 gong2 bei2 coi3。
text: 佢一開始嗰陣都唔知自己贏咗場演講比賽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you agree to buy 3,000 of them, we'll give you a 3 percent discount.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hang2 maai5 gau3 saam1 cin1 go3，ngo5 dei6 zau6 bei2 go3 gau2 cat1 zit3 nei5。
text: 如果你肯買夠三千個，我哋就俾個九七折你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Living in the country, we have few amusements.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hoeng1 cyun1 dei6 fong1 zyu6，mou5 me1 jyu4 lok6。
text: 我哋喺鄉村地方住，冇咩娛樂。

author: nickyeow

english.text: May I have a look at your ticket?

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tai2 jat1 tai2 nei5 zoeng1 fei1 aa3？
text: 我可唔可以睇一睇你張飛呀？

author: fercheung

english.text: No one knows the fact.

jyutping: mou5 jan4 zi1 dou6 zan1 soeng3 hai6 dim2。
text: 冇人知道真相係點。

author: kaenif

english.text: Gosh, can you be more wasteful?

jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 daai6 saai1 di1？
text: 你唔好再大嘥啲？

author: kaenif

english.text: However vast the darkness, we must supply our own light.

jyutping: mou4 leon6 hak1 am3 jau5 gei2 liu4 fut3，ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 tai4 gung1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gwong1。
text: 無論黑暗有幾遼闊，我哋都要提供自己嘅光。

author: kaenif

english.text: Organic vegetables are popular because they're safe and tasty.

jyutping: jau5 gei1 coi3 gam3 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 jau6 on1 cyun4 jau6 hou2 sik6。
text: 有機菜咁多人鍾意係因為佢哋又安全又好食。

author: kaenif

english.text: French was the language of diplomacy.

jyutping: faat3 man4 cang4 ging1 hai6 ngoi6 gaau1 jyu5 jin4。
text: 法文曾經係外交語言。

author: kaenif

english.text: That changes nothing.

jyutping: gam2 goi2 bin3 m4 dou3 jam6 ho4 je5。
text: 噉改變唔到任何嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I've got enough money for a car.

jyutping: ngo5 gau3 cin4 maai5 ce1。
text: 我夠錢買車。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We live in a civilized society.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sang1 wut6 hai2 man4 ming4 se5 wui2。
text: 我哋生活喺文明社會。

author: WilliamKwok

english.text: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.

jyutping: seoi1 jin4 jau5 jik6 ging2，gin3 zuk1 si1 zung6 hai6 jing4 ceoi2 zo2 hoeng2 jyu6 cyun4 kau4 ge3 ming4 jyu6。
text: 虽然有逆境，建筑师仲系赢取咗享誉全球嘅名誉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Modern art doesn't interest me.

jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 jin6 doi6 ngai6 seot6 mou5 mat1 hing3 ceoi3。
text: 我對現代藝術冇乜興趣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla was very upset.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1。
text: 蕾拉好唔開心。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Do you like spicy food?" "I love it."

jyutping: 「nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 laat6 gaa3？」「ciu1 kap1 zung1 ji3。」
text: 「你鍾唔鍾意食辣㗎？」「超級鍾意。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: Forgot password?

jyutping: m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 mat6 maa5？
text: 唔記得咗密碼？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You could really do with a haircut.

jyutping: nei5 hou2 zin2 haa5 tau4 faat3 laa3 wo3。
text: 你好剪吓頭髮喇喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: All unclaimed property will be disposed of at midday tomorrow.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 di1 je5 mou5 jan4 ling1 zau2，ting1 jat6 aan3 zau3 sap6 ji6 dim2 zau6 wui6 dam2。
text: 如果啲嘢冇人拎走，聽日晏晝十二點就會抌。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There was once a man who was the laziest man in all the world. He wouldn't take off his clothes when he went to bed because he didn't want to have to put them on again. He wouldn't raise his cup to his lips but went down and sucked up his tea without carrying the cup. He wouldn't play any sports because he said they made him sweat. And he wouldn't work with his hands for the same reason.

jyutping: cang4 ging1 jau5 go3 naam4 jan2 hai6 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 zeoi3 laan5 ge3 jan4。keoi5 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6 m4 wui5 ceoi4 saam1，jan1 wai6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 zoek6。keoi5 m4 wui5 zoeng1 bui1 toi4 dou3 seon4 bin1，ji4 hai6 lok6 heoi3 kap1 caa4，m4 ling1 zyu6 bui1。keoi5 m4 wui5 waan2 jam6 ho4 wan6 dung6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 waa6 wan6 dung6 wui5 ling6 keoi5 ceot1 hon6，ji4 ce2 keoi5 m4 wui5 jung6 sau2 zou6 je5，jyun4 jan1 dou1 hai6 jat1 joeng6。
text: 曾經有個男人係全世界最懶嘅人。佢瞓覺嗰陣唔會除衫，因為佢唔想再着。佢唔會將杯抬到唇邊，而係落去吸茶，唔拎住杯。佢唔會玩任何運動，因為佢話運動會令佢出汗，而且佢唔會用手做嘢，原因都係一樣。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Systems in which the rules are based on usage, such as languages or customary law, are condemned to become absurd, cumbersome and contradictory, since every time a small error slips into one of their usages, it is integrated into the rules, by definition, for eternity. The more users are ignorant, the more systems degrade rapidly. English, poorly used by millions of people, natives or not, for centuries, is an example of the degradation of a system at terminal stage, no longer presenting any logic, neither in its syntax, nor its grammar, nor its vocabulary or its pronunciation. Similarly, with customary rights becoming too cumbersome and incomprehensible, the states which rely on them tend to switch to prescriptive law.

jyutping: kwai1 zak1 hai6 gei1 jyu1 jung6 faat3 ge3 hai6 tung2，lai6 jyu4 jyu5 jin4 waak6 ze2 fung1 zuk6 faat3，zau6 bei6 hin2 zaak3 wui6 bin3 dak1 fong1 mau6、faan4 so2 tung4 maau4 teon5，jan1 wai6 mui5 ci3 jau5 jat1 go3 siu2 co3 ng6 waat6 jap6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 jung6 faat3，zau6 wui6 bei6 zing2 hap6 dou3 kwai1 zak1 jap6 min6，gan1 geoi3 ding6 ji6，jung6 wu6 jyut6 hai6 mou4 zi1，hai6 tung2 zau6 jyut6 hai6 faai3 cuk1 teoi3 faa3，m4 hai6 gei2 baak3 maan6 jan4 jung6 dak1 m4 hou2，hai6 jat1 go3 m4 hai6 gei2 sai3 gei2 ge3 jan4，m4 hai6 jat1 go3 lai6 zi2 cing4 jin6 jam6 ho4 lo4 cap1，mou4 leon6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 jyu5 faat3，ding6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 man4 faat3，ding6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 ci4 wui6 waak6 ze2 keoi5 ge3 faat3 jam1，tung4 joeng6 dei6，ceoi4 zyu6 fung1 zuk6 kyun4 lei6 bin3 dak1 taai3 gwo3 faan4 so2 tung4 naan4 ji5 lei5 gaai2，ji1 laai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 tung1 soeng4 wui6 zyun2 hoeng3 kwai1 ding6 faat3 leot6。
text: 規則係基於用法嘅系統，例如語言或者風俗法，就被譴責會變得荒謬、繁瑣同矛盾，因為每次有一個小錯誤滑入其中一個用法，就會被整合到規則入面，根據定義，用戶越係無知，系統就越係快速退化，唔係幾百萬人用得唔好，係一個唔係幾世紀嘅人，唔係一個例子呈現任何邏輯，無論係佢嘅語法，定係佢嘅文法，定係佢嘅詞彙或者佢嘅發音，同樣地，隨住風俗權利變得太過繁瑣同難以理解，依賴佢哋嘅國家通常會轉向規定法律。
